cycle_time_median.label: Cycle time, median
cycle_time_median.method: completed minus started, items completed in the window

cycle_time_p85.label: Cycle time, 85th percentile
cycle_time_p85.method: nearest rank, items completed in the window

lane_ratio.label: Median cycle time, bug over feature
lane_ratio.method: fastest over slowest work-type median, types with 10 or more completed items

reopen_rate.label: Share of completed items reopened
reopen_rate.method: items with reopened above 0, of items completed in the window

acceptance_criteria_share.label: Share of started items with acceptance criteria

wip_per_person.label: Work in progress, mean
wip_per_person.method: items in progress per assignee per day, averaged over the window

cycles_in_window.label: Cycles ending in the window
cycles_in_window.method: cycles whose end falls in the window

unplanned_share.label: Share of cycle work added after the cycle started
unplanned_share.method: items with planned false, of items in cycles ending in the window

planning_accuracy.label: Planning accuracy
planning_accuracy.method: planned items completed by their cycle end, of planned items

pr_authors.label: Pull request authors
pr_authors.method: distinct authors of pull requests opened in the window

review_wait_median.label: Time to first review, median
review_wait_median.method: first review minus opened, calendar hours

review_coverage.label: Share of merged pull requests with an approval

cross_functional_squads.label: Share of squads with product, design and engineering
cross_functional_squads.method: squads listing pm, design and eng roles

epic_success_criteria.label: Share of epics with success criteria

dimensions.name: Team Orchestration
dimensions.question: Are teams organised for cross-functional collaboration, not silos?

findings.says: Share of squads with product, design and engineering: 83%. Cross-functional squads are the norm (rubric Stage 3).
findings.next_step: Show Stage 4: move operational expertise into squads so no separate team gates their work.

findings.says: Time to first review, median: 30 hours. Work waits more than a day for a second pair of eyes, so collaboration is not yet the default (rubric Stage 4).
findings.next_step: Set a same-day first-review norm with a named reviewer rota per squad, and track the median weekly.

findings.says: Slowest squads by median time to first review: Data (39 hours), Chasing (33 hours), Payments (33 hours).

dimensions.name: Process & Iteration

findings.says: Share of retro actions closed within 30 days: 20%. Retros surface friction but few fixes close (rubric Stage 2).
findings.next_step: Cut each retro to one action with a named owner and a 2-week due date, and open the next retro with its result.

dimensions.survey_disagrees: The team's own view sits more than a stage away from what the exports show. Ask why before acting on either.
